evidence: Verg. G. 3.284: sed fugit intereā, fugit irreparābile tempus
terms.comment: Literally “time flies, never to be regained”.
The modern tag, from Vergil’s line. We have found no ancient source for it in Lewis & Short or the loci collections. Every word is classical; we have found no classical instance of the phrase.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency.
Quotations from the Latinitas loci collections, checked against the editions named there.
